checks.evidence: Frames 0.00, 0.67 (cut), 1.50, 3.00, 4.50, 6.00, 7.10 (cut), 7.50, 9.00, 10.50, 10.90 (end card cut), 12.00, 13.50 checked. After the H3 cut at 0.667 s the close shot puts the owner's head under the hook super: 0.70, 1.00, 2.00, 2.30 and 2.60 s show his hair starting exactly at the red box's bottom edge (y 554) with the crown hidden behind the box (ear top at y about 557; at 3.00 s, with the super gone, the crown is at y about 380). Minor: model-drawn packaging in the lit shop window (red cans with a white Coca-Cola-like script, boxes with gibberish lettering), lower left y 1380-1780, visible 0.67-6.9 s, only readable zoomed; kiosk posters with blurred pseudo-text at x 90-300, y 720-1100, 7.1-10.9 s. Clean: no morphing, melting, flicker or duplicate people; hands correct at 0.67, 1.5, 3.0, 4.5, 6.0; the red phone stays in his left jacket pocket; the two walkers 7.1-10.9 s stay two and at distance; 24 to 30 fps conform by frame repeat (every 5th frame duplicated), as STANDARDS 5 asks. Note (not counted): the one silent H3 keyframe clip holds 3 shots (cuts at 0.667 and 7.1 s) against STANDARDS 2's one-shot rule for silent keyframe clips; the cuts themselves read cleanly. Picture changes: cuts at 0.67, 7.1, 10.9 s; 0.67-7.1 s is one continuous shot (6.4 s) in which the action changes (pull down, turn, step back) every 1 to 2 s.

Sound-off: the hook reads from frame 1 ('Kjo javë e vështirë / është për tani,' then 'jo përgjithmonë.' on red at 2.1 s), the story reads as an owner pulling his shutter down at night, then looking down the wet street to the clock tower, and every spoken word is on screen; the end card carries the send ask. The head occlusion in F1/F3 weakens the 0.67-3.0 s hook frames but does not stop the read.

Everything else passes. (exactly the script), no em dashes. Hook super: 6 words, top third, on from frame 1 (0.000 s) to 3.000 s, top edge y 308 (limit 269), 84 px. Cards 1 to 4 words (2, 2, 3, 3, 1, 3, 2, 3). Size: every lower card measures 80 px Montserrat ExtraBold (79.5 to 80.3 by ink width), at the floor of 80 to 100. Timing (card on vs word onset): jo 2.10/2.26, Ke 3.60/3.62, edhe 4.07/4.16, Mbylle 5.73/about 5.75, pusho 6.90/about 7.0, dhe 7.87/about 7.87, nga 8.93/about 8.9, gjë 9.20/9.20; last card held to 10.87 s. All 25 scripted words present in order (spelling misreads are Whisper's, STANDARDS 4). faster-whisper small (sq) gives the same words but repeats 'për sotë' over 6.96-7.86 s where medium and the energy envelope place 'pusho' (7.06-7.62 s); no extra or missing words. Hook text is on screen from frame 1 and the picture moves from frame 1 (frame difference 0.9 to 2.3 per frame before the 0.667 s cut).

defects.what: The hook super covers the shop owner's head after the 0.667 s cut: crown hidden behind the red 'është për tani,' box (bottom y 554); the cover (hero) shows the same.
No 'AI label: on' note on the hub draft (item.json has no notes), and item.json/hosted.json still carry the v1 reel and cover URLs.
Loudness range over 11 LU: 11.2 LU (ebur128) and 13.9 LU (loudnorm), from the end-card music fade.
Model-drawn packaging text and a Coca-Cola-like script on cans in the shop window (lower left), and blurred pseudo-text on the kiosk posters.
The shutter stops about 70% down with the lit window open below while he turns away on 'Mbylle për sot'.
The 'nga një' card is on screen only 0.27 s (8 frames).

edit_fixes: D1: clear the head in 0.67-3.0 s. The free band above his crown is only y 269 to about 370, so the two-line super cannot stay as is. Preferred: make the super one line, 'Kjo javë e vështirë' (4 words), box top at y 270 and box bottom at y 370 or above (about 64 to 70 px type with about 15 px box padding, ink about 620 to 680 px wide); show 'është për tani,' as a red lower card from about 1.05 s (word 'është' at 1.08 s), then 'jo përgjithmonë.' as now. Keep the super from frame 1 to about 2.9 s. Check every frame 0.67-3.0 s at 0.1 s that the box ends at least 10 px above the hair. Then re-export the cover from the fixed cut (the cover is a hero asset: zero defects).

D2: before the hub push, set item.json notes to 'AI label: on (realistic AI footage, ElevenLabs narrator)', point media[0].url and cover_url (and hosted.json) at the passing version's URLs, and switch the label on when posting.

D3: hold the end-card bed at about -20 to -22 LUFS short-term until about 13.1 s and fade only over the last 0.5 s (or lift the bed under the end card by 3 to 4 dB); run two-pass loudnorm again and confirm I -14 +/-1, TP -1 dBTP or lower and LRA 11 LU or less on both ebur128 and loudnorm.

D6: re-split the last line so no card runs under about 0.5 s: 'dhe nesër' 7.87-8.60 s, 'fillo nga një' 8.60-9.20 s, 'gjë e vogël.' 9.20-10.87 s (all 2 to 3 words, same style, same band; 'fillo nga një' at 80 px is about 560 px wide, so it fits inside x 65-853).

D4: optional: a soft blur or 15 to 20% darken on the lit shop window's lower-left shelves (x 0-400, y 1380-1800) for 0.67-6.9 s; otherwise accept as minor (only readable zoomed, inside the bottom 35%).
D5: accept as minor; only a retake shows the shutter fully down.
